title: Great kitchen tools.
text: Great kitchen tools.. When I ordered these I didnt realize how big the largest one was lol. This makes it good for times when you have a lot of veggies to drain, pasta...just about anything. They are just a bit heavier than most but I think its because of the quality material it is made from. The handles are sturdy and feel good in your hand. I like the variety of the 3 sizes.

product_metadata.title: Proto Future Strainer Set Fine Mesh – Premium 304 Stainless Steel (18/8) – 3.3″, 5.5″ and 8″ Sturdy Kitchen Strainers (Gold)
features: HIGH QUALITY 304 STAINLESS STEEL STRAINER SET - made from professional quality and premium 304 stainless steel. They are built to last as they are much stronger, resistant, durable and anticorrosive than cheaper 201 stainless steel and plastic strainer alternatives

3.3″, 5.5″ & 8″ SIZES WITH FINE TWILL MESH - organise yourself with our professional quality kitchen strainer set of 3, 3.3″,5.5″ and 8″. Our unique strainers, larger than average sizes are versatile for a wide range of needs in the kitchen. Each strainer features fine twill mesh and a sturdy handle, so they can be hung or stacked for easy storage

TITANIUM ECO-FRIENDLY AND STYLISH GOLD COLOR FINISH - our kitchen strainers feature a titanium Physical Vapour Deposition eco-friendly coating. The PVD applied to all our food strainers is the highest quality coating and the entire process is environmentally harmless

VERSATILE FOR USE IN THE KITCHEN - whether you need to drain, strain or sieve then you will achieve excellent results with our kitchen strainers. Pasta, vegetables, fruits, rice, quinoa, almond milk, smoothies, flour, sauces, gravy and more can be prepared to perfection with one of our strainers. Food won’t get stuck under the rim making it easy and convenient to clean

THE ULTIMATE MULTIPURPOSE KITCHEN UTENSIL WITH 100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE – this strainer set has been tested in the SGS laboratories and the PVD Coating is dishwasher safe (certified test of 25 cycles), for best long-lasting results we advise to easily wash by hand. Our fine mesh strainer set is built to last and won’t break. So you can purchase and use at home with complete peace of mind
